explanations.3: This environment variable tells Ubuntu's package manager to skip interactive prompts during installation, so the Docker build doesn't hang waiting for user input.
explanations.7: This sed command modifies Ubuntu's package repository configuration file to enable additional software repositories (universe and multiverse) beyond the default ones, so we can install packages like fzf.
explanations.15: After installing packages, we delete the cached package lists to reduce the final image size — this is a standard Docker optimization.
explanations.24: We're creating a bare Git repository (one with no working files) that acts like a remote server so the demo can practice pushing code somewhere.
explanations.71: This extracts the first field from the git worktree list output using awk, which is a text-processing tool that splits lines into columns.
explanations.75: This zsh syntax `${...}` expands a variable, and the `////-` part replaces all forward slashes in the branch name with hyphens to create a valid directory name.
explanations.86: The autoload command tells zsh to load the gwt function from the fpath (function path) when it's first called, rather than loading it upfront.
explanations.87: The `>>` appends text to the end of the file, whereas `>` would overwrite the whole file.
explanations.92: This adds a fancy colored prompt with a whale emoji to make it visually clear you're running commands inside a container.
